paper.title: Confucius Code Agent: Scalable Agent Scaffolding for Real-World Codebases
paper.central_claim: CCA以分层上下文、持久笔记和meta-agent自动build-test-improve在可比骨干/工具条件下提高软件工程解题率，并支持跨会话持续学习。

provenance.notes: 本席按已配置 sonnet→gpt-6.1-sol 执行；没有独立可核验服务端 model/session/receipt，按模板置 null；不探测模型。

sections_read: Appendix A–H，含全部轨迹、示例代码、笔记和案例

evidence.quote: Agents should accumulate persistent knowledge across tasks and sessions, capturing reusable patterns, failure modes, and invariants, rather than repeatedly rediscovering information or reproducing past mistakes.
evidence.support_explanation: 具体问题为跨会话重复探索及长上下文，不只冻结权重。

evidence.quote: The memory is organized as a tree-structured namespace where internal nodes represent semantic groupings and leaf nodes store Markdown documents annotated with metadata tags.
evidence.support_explanation: 树形工作记忆与 Markdown 叶节点可重建。

evidence.quote:
A dedicated
note-taking agent
can distill these trajectories into compact notes without affecting the online latency of the primary agent.
evidence.support_explanation: 异步轨迹到笔记的生产者。

evidence.quote: When a similar failure appears in a future session, an agent can retrieve the corresponding hindsight note and immediately surface known fixes or workarounds, rather than rediscovering them from scratch.
evidence.support_explanation: 失败经验持久化后检索使用的机制声明。

evidence.quote: then repeatedly refine them against a production-grade test set until performance stabilizes.
evidence.support_explanation: 配置/提示与工具被测试反馈迭代，但选择集与最终测试的关系未交代。

evidence.quote: These patches are applied to the agent, and the test loop is rerun, yielding a “build-test-improve” process that incrementally improves the agent until target metrics are met.
evidence.support_explanation: 真实对象为 harness 提示、工具包装与配置；不是自改 improver。

evidence.quote: Each trial is repeated with different random seeds for trajectory sampling to account for randomness in tool invocation and LLM responses. We report mean Resolve Rate (Pass@1) across three runs.
evidence.support_explanation: 三次重复但未提供跨运行误差条或显著性。

evidence.quote: We follow the official SWE-Bench-Pro Resolve Rate metric, defined as the percentage of tasks for which the agent’s proposed patch successfully passes all repository-provided tests without human intervention.
evidence.support_explanation: 执行测试作为结果验证器，不是我们运行。

evidence.quote: To quantify the impact of hierarchical working memory and context compression, we evaluate CCA on a subset of SWE-Bench-Pro, where both variants (with and without context management) successfully produced executable solutions.
evidence.support_explanation: 按两组都能产生可执行补丁筛选，限制消融外推；归于因果项。

evidence.quote: We then rerun exactly these 151 tasks, providing CCA with the corresponding note directory to measure how prior experience improves efficiency and solution quality.
evidence.support_explanation: 严格是同实例二次尝试，不是独立任务迁移。
151例笔记重用报告 +1.4pp，104k→93k，但未含全部优化成本。

evidence.quote: Token cost excludes system prompt tokens; the underlying model is Claude 4.5 Sonnet.
evidence.support_explanation: 成本口径明确有排除项。

evidence.quote: Under identical conditions, haiku-based summarization resolves 22/50 instances, while Sonnet-based summarization resolves 26/50.
evidence.support_explanation: 50例摘要质量对照支持条件性测量；小样本不重复扣 measurement。

evidence.quote: studies test-time self-evolution, adapting strategies and occasionally updating prompts, tools, or configuration mid-run based on partial progress.
evidence.support_explanation: Live-SWE-Agent 最近邻只核本文转述，无邻居独立原文。

evidence.quote: The note is well organized into ”shared” (ONLY for truly generic insights that apply across MANY projects) and ”project” (For project-specific knowledge that primarily applies to ONE specific domain).
evidence.support_explanation: 作者区分通用与项目笔记，但案例不足证明跨任务收益。
